text_block_list.text:
The Mainichi Hai, Матиканэфукукитару's
"Dragon
Gate" and our spring hurdle to
the Classics, is
upon us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Determined to soar through the race like
a carp
swimming up a waterfall and show
everyone her
transformation into a
fearsome classic-year racer,

Matikanefukukitaru heads to the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
